title: Labour Market and the Education System
text: Research and explain the key aspects of the labour market and the education system.
cdi_links: 4.E.02 Researching the labour market and the education system

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: How to research the labour market
How education pathways connect to careers
How to use reliable sources for career information
How labour market trends influence opportunities

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can research job roles and education pathways using reliable sources
I can explain key information about the labour market
I can recognise labour market trends and future opportunities
I can reflect on how my skills and interests link to real jobs

title: Key Words
bullets: Career Pathway – The planned route you take towards a job, including courses, training, and work experience.
Labour Market Trends – Patterns and changes in the world of work showing which jobs and skills are in demand.
Accredited Source – A trusted and official place to find reliable information, such as government career websites or industry reports.

title: Understanding the Labour Market
bullets: The labour market shows what jobs are available and what skills are needed.
It also shows how work is changing over time.
Trends may include growing sectors, skill shortages, and new opportunities.
Understanding these patterns helps you choose a realistic career pathway.

title: Using Reliable Information
bullets: Use trustworthy sources such as government careers websites.
Industry reports can show which jobs are growing or declining.
Training providers can explain qualification pathways.
Reliable information helps you make informed career decisions.

title: Activity 1 – Career Research
text: Choose a career you are curious about

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: The labour market shows how jobs and skills change over time
Reliable information sources help you understand career opportunities
Researching jobs helps you plan future education and career pathways
